clue.text: This office may have been arranged if involved with church

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of 'been' are set out in a new order
involved means twisted up, so the two letters of 'if' are tangled into a new order

parts.note: CE is the usual abbreviation for the Church of England

explanation.surface: A job description: this post might have been set up had the church been involved.
explanation.walkthrough: Each half of the fodder has its own anagram signal: 'arranged' works on the first word, 'involved' on the second, and the church abbreviation follows. 'This office' is the definition, a church living.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefice is an ecclesiastical living, the paid position of a parish priest.

clue.text: Genial head of government in African republic

indicators.note: in means the leading letter sits inside the country's name

parts.note: Benin is a republic in West Africa

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A friendly leader of a West African state.
explanation.definitionFit: Benign means kindly and gentle, friendly in manner.

clue.text: Bases clue in anagram

indicators.note: the word anagram itself tells the solver to rearrange the letters of clue and in

explanation.surface: A setter's confession: this clue is founded on an anagram.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anagram' is frank about the device: rearrange CLUE and IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A nucleus is a core or centre, the basis on which something is built.

clue.text: Gnome's fashionable, when accepted by connoisseur

indicators.note: accepted by means taken inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a fancier is an enthusiast and judge of something, such as pigeons
in means fashionable, as in 'the in thing'

explanation.surface: A garden gnome is in vogue, and a collector welcomes it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gnome' is not a garden ornament but one of the 'Gnomes of Zurich', a nickname for Swiss bankers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gnomes of Zurich was a disparaging name for Swiss bankers and money dealers.

clue.text: Records agreement to confer : without us

parts.note: a compact is an agreement or pact

indicators.note: without means minus, so the letters of us are dropped from the word for confer

parts.note: to confer is to talk things over, to discuss

explanation.surface: A deal is struck to talk it over without our involvement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes US from DISCUSS, leaving DISCS.
explanation.definitionFit: Compact discs are recordings of music on optical disc, so they are records.

clue.text: High-flier ruined by exposure in Sun

definitions.text: High-flier ruined by exposure in Sun

parts.words: High-flier ruined by exposure in Sun
parts.note: the youth of Greek myth whose wings of feathers and wax melted when he flew too near the sun, so that he fell into the sea

explanation.surface: A newspaper story: a celebrity brought down by revelations printed in a tabloid, the Sun.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like a scandal in the Sun, a British tabloid newspaper; literally it is the mythical boy whose flight ended when the sun's heat melted his wings.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend the son of Daedalus flew on waxen wings, soared too high, and fell when the heat melted them.

clue.text: Redhead embraced by a silly French painter .

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside, so one letter sits within the other word

parts.note: a coot is a silly person, a fool
the head of 'red' is its first letter, R

explanation.surface: A ginger-haired man is hugged by a foolish French artist.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs on into the next clue for surface only.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot was a nineteenth-century French landscape artist.

clue.text: … while English artists introduce Russian monk

parts.note: RAs are Royal Academicians, members of the Royal Academy of Arts in London
to introduce something is to put it in

explanation.surface: Continuing on, English painters bring in a Russian holy man.
explanation.walkthrough: PUT IN is read as one word. The leading dots join the surface to the previous clue; 'while' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Grigori Rasputin was the mystic Siberian holy man who gained influence at the Russian imperial court.

clue.text: Dull race is hard to follow

indicators.note: to follow means the next letter comes after the others

parts.note: stock is lineage, race or breed
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A boring race is difficult to keep up with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'race' is not a contest but a breed, STOCK.
explanation.definitionFit: Stockish means stupid and dull, like a block of wood.

clue.text: Capability, for example, producing appropriate celebrity

parts.note: to appropriate is to steal, which in slang is to nick
a name is a famous person, as in 'a big name'

explanation.surface: Someone's ability produces a fitting fame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capability' looks like an abstract noun but is Lancelot 'Capability' Brown, the English landscape gardener, whose famous epithet is the example. 'appropriate' is the verb, not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Capability was the informal epithet given to the gardener Lancelot Brown, an example of an affectionate byname.

clue.text: Powerful openers, before: and after interval, scored rapidly

indicators.note: one piece goes before and the other after, so the opening pair is split around the interval

parts.note: the openers of 'Powerful' are its first two letters, P and O
a rest is an interval of silence in music

explanation.surface: Cricket: strong opening batsmen, either side of the break, made their runs quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture of openers scoring fast misleads: 'scored' is musical, written in a score. P goes before REST and O after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Presto is the musical tempo marking meaning very fast, written into a score.

clue.text: Protestant start'd on Rome after Reformation

indicators.note: a reformation is a re-forming, so the letters of start'd on Rome are re-formed

explanation.surface: Religious history: a Protestant began on Rome after the Reformation.
explanation.walkthrough: The church history surface misleads: 'Protestant' is simply one who protests, and 'Reformation' signals re-forming the letters of START'D ON ROME.
explanation.definitionFit: One who protests in a march or rally is a protester, a placard-carrying activist.

clue.text: Go-ahead political type?

definitions.meaning: the go-ahead is permission to proceed, given by the colour of a traffic light that says go
a member of an environmentalist party, an ecology campaigner in politics

explanation.surface: An energetic, ambitious sort of politician.
explanation.definitionFit: The traffic light colour signals go, so it means permission; and a member of the ecology party is called by the same colour.

clue.text: A film actress has undistinguished crowd stunned

parts.note: Mae West was a Hollywood film actress
the ruck is the common herd, an undistinguished mass of people

explanation.surface: A movie star is mobbed by an ordinary crowd and left dazed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone filled with awe is dumbfounded, overwhelmed and amazed.

clue.text: In a manner of speaking, sign references

parts.note: diction is one's manner of speaking, the choice and delivery of words
Aries, the Ram, is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: So to speak, a signal gives references.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a manner of speaking' reads as the stock phrase 'so to speak'; here it gives DICTION, with 'In' a link. 'sign' is the zodiac.
explanation.definitionFit: Dictionaries are reference books, the works one consults for meanings.

clue.text: Military command anticipated by. Janus

parts.note: Janus, the two-faced Roman god, already looks both ways, as if he had obeyed the parade-ground order to turn round

explanation.surface: An army order that a Roman god saw coming.
explanation.definitionFit: The parade-ground order to turn and face the other way, which the two-faced god has no need to obey.

clue.text: Spring into channel in haste

indicators.note: into means the spring is put inside the channel

parts.note: a ditch is a channel dug for water
a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: Leap into the canal in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spring' reads as a verb, leap; it is a mineral spring, SPA.
explanation.definitionFit: Dispatch means speed and promptness, as in 'with dispatch'.

clue.text: Firm helping to instal war tanks

indicators.note: a helping is a portion, so a portion of these words supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A company assists in installing armoured vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: Stalwart means steadfast and unwavering, loyal and strong.

clue.text: Get into ground before goal brings stoppage

parts.note: to inter is to bury, putting someone into the ground
a mission is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Football: get the ball into the ground ahead of a goal and play stops.
explanation.walkthrough: The football picture misleads: 'ground' is earth, not a stadium, and 'goal' is an aim.
explanation.definitionFit: An interval or pause in a performance is a break, a halt in proceedings.

clue.text: Omitted, because understood

parts.note: for means because, as in 'for he was tired'
to get something is to understand it, as in 'I got the joke'

explanation.surface: Left out, because the point was taken.
explanation.definitionFit: To omit something by oversight is to fail to remember it.

clue.text: A good 'deal isn't as difficult as this

definitions.text: A good 'deal isn't as difficult as this

parts.words: A good 'deal isn't as difficult as this
parts.note: deal is softwood timber, and good-quality boards are free of the hard tangled spots where branches grew

explanation.surface: A bargain is easier to strike than this problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A good deal' reads as a bargain; it is quality pine or fir timber, which has few knots.
explanation.definitionFit: Knotty means full of knots in wood, and also intricate and hard to solve.

clue.text: Alternative to station wagon?

parts.note: a station wagon is an estate car, but read 'station' as the local constabulary's base, whose vehicle is a patrol car

explanation.surface: Shopping for a family car: what else instead of an estate?
explanation.definitionFit: A patrol vehicle belongs to the police station, so it is a wagon of the station in a punning sense.

clue.text: I see you are initially heard before a court of sorts

indicators.note: initially means the spoken letters come first, ahead of the others
heard means the words see you are are spoken, giving the sounds of three letters

parts.note: spoken aloud, see you are sounds like the letters C, U and R

explanation.surface: Someone notes you are heard first before some kind of court.
explanation.walkthrough: The spoken C-U-R comes first ('initially'), then I before A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Curia is the papal court, the administrative body of the Roman Catholic Church; in Rome it was also a senate house.

clue.text: Ancient character Androcles disposed of

definitions.meaning: an Old English runic letter for the 'th' sound
in the fable Androcles pulled a sharp spike from a lion's paw, and the lion later spared him

explanation.surface: Androcles, a figure from antiquity, got rid of something.
explanation.definitionFit: The runic letter for th in Old English bears the same name as the spike the slave drew from the lion's paw.

clue.text: Vessel of' unusual nature, discharged in China.

indicators.note: unusual means the letters of 'nature' are put into an odd new order

explanation.surface: A ship of strange character was unloaded in a Chinese port.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a ship unloaded in China; really it is a kitchen vessel, and 'discharged in China' adds a cryptic touch: its contents are poured into china cups.
explanation.definitionFit: A large metal container with a tap, used for making and serving tea in quantity.

clue.text: Unqualified? Take final part of course

definitions.meaning: unqualified means plain and without reservations, as in a direct answer
the home stretch of a racecourse before the finishing post

explanation.surface: No diploma? Then take the last module of the course.
explanation.definitionFit: A direct, unhedged reply is undiluted; and the run-in to the finish on a racetrack is the home stretch of the same name.

clue.text: Assassin arrived in island

parts.note: to hit a place is to arrive there, as in 'hit town'
Man is the Isle of Man, an island in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A killer has landed on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A hired killer is a contract killer, paid to murder.

clue.text: With expedition, find ancient city easily

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia
gently means easily, without strain

explanation.surface: An archaeological dig: on an expedition, the ancient city is found without difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' suggests a dig, which suits the ancient city; here it means speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition is promptness and speed, so acting with it means acting fast and pressingly.
